transcript.text: I need to raise a concern for the readiness review. While investigating an unrelated mobile authentication ticket this morning, I confirmed that clients below Android SDK version 8.4 reject the new JWT signing key identifier. About 17% of active mobile sessions still use those older clients. The good news is we have a compatibility bridge that can be enabled before rotation, but it requires a seven-day overlap period with the old keys. I have not yet filed the compatibility note, but this needs to be addressed in the runbook before we proceed with Saturday's rotation.

transcript.text: I need to raise a compliance concern for the readiness review. During this week's SOC 2 audit preparation, I confirmed that our production key-rotation control requires two-person approval and a before-and-after key-fingerprint evidence package before the change can be closed. I have not yet added that control detail to the change ticket. This safeguard needs to be documented in the runbook before approval so we can capture the required fingerprint evidence and record the two-person approval.

commitments.detail: Document the HSM vendor limit of four key activations per 60-minute period and structure the rotation as three waves with at least 60 minutes between waves to stay within the activation rate limit.
Add the compatibility bridge enablement step before rotation and document the required seven-day overlap period with old keys to support clients below Android SDK version 8.4.
Add two-person approval requirement and before-and-after key-fingerprint evidence capture steps to the runbook and change ticket for SOC 2 compliance.

The reserved Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC window accommodates three waves with 60-minute spacing (approximately 2 hours of active rotation time) plus the compatibility bridge enablement and fingerprint evidence capture steps.
